source_note: Facts cross-checked against the app's question bank and standard references.

bullets.en: 7 provinces, 77 districts, 6 metropolitan cities, 753 local levels.
Mt Everest (Sagarmatha): 8,848.86 m — the world's highest. Lowest point: Kechana Kalan, Jhapa (60 m).
bullets.ne: सगरमाथा: 8,848.86 मि. — विश्वको सर्वोच्च। होचो ठाउँ: केचना कलन, झापा (60 मि.)।

bullets.en: 8 of the world's 10 highest peaks are in Nepal.
Three ecological belts: Himal (mountain), Pahad (hill), Terai (plain).
bullets.ne: तीन भौगोलिक क्षेत्र: हिमाल, पहाड, तराई।

bullets.en: Major river systems: Koshi (east), Gandaki/Narayani (central), Karnali (west) — all flow south into the Ganges.
bullets.ne: प्रमुख नदी प्रणाली: कोशी (पूर्व), गण्डकी/नारायणी (मध्य), कर्णाली (पश्चिम) — सबै दक्षिण बगेर गङ्गामा मिसिन्छन्।

bullets.en: Longest river: Karnali (507 km inside Nepal).
Largest lake: Rara; deepest lake: Shey-Phoksundo.
bullets.ne: सबैभन्दा ठूलो ताल: रारा; गहिरो: शे-फोक्सुण्डो।

bullets.en: Neighbours: China (north), India (east, west, south). Nepal is landlocked.
bullets.ne: छिमेकी: चीन (उत्तर), भारत (पूर्व, पश्चिम, दक्षिण)। नेपाल भूपरिवेष्टित छ।

bullets.en: The Terai is the grain store of Nepal; the Himal region is sparsely populated.
bullets.ne: तराई नेपालको अन्न भण्डार; हिमाली क्षेत्रमा जनसङ्ख्या पातलो।

bullets.en: Climate varies with altitude: tropical in the Terai to tundra/arctic on the high Himal.
bullets.ne: उचाइअनुसार हावापानी: तराईमा उष्णदेखि उच्च हिमालमा टुन्ड्रा/आर्कटिक।
